titles.title: Calla Lily in Tall Glass, No. I
Calla Lily in Tall Glass No. I

description: A tall, slender calla lily with a bright green stem sits in a narrow glass vase. A yellow spike protrudes from the white petal of the lily. The objects are framed by narrow, overlapping gray forms.
title: Calla Lily – Tall Glass – No. 1
